statuses.quote: Sometimes life changes in ways you could never imagine or prepare for. I'm currently dealing with an unexpected health issue that will keep me away fro a little while. While I'm not ready to share the details at this time, I hope you understand and respect my privacy until I am ready to share more.
statuses.note: Her own public Instagram statement, reported by Yahoo Sports / Purdue Boilermakers On SI (Dustin Schutte, 2026-08-27). The typo 'fro' is hers and is preserved -- the quote is verbatim. Coach Dave Shondell, same report: "We don't know when for sure she'll be back. That's all I can say." NO diagnosis, hospital, season-ending status or return date is sourced, so none may render. Corroborating participation fact: Creighton's own Aug 28 recap says Purdue 'played without Second Team All-American Kenna Wollard (personal reasons)'.

statuses.quote: A Monday MRI confirmed the worst fears for Texas volleyball and outside hitter Abby Vander Wal. Vander Wal, a 6-foot-3 starting outside hitter, tore the ACL in her left knee during Saturday's win over TCU and will likely miss the remainder of the season.
statuses.summary: Left ACL tear reported after Monday MRI
statuses.note: Austin American-Statesman (Thomas Jones, 2026-08-31), read via its Yahoo syndication. This is a BEAT REPORT of the MRI result -- no Texas Athletics release is held and none is implied. The injury occurred 2026-08-29 v TCU at the Players Era Showcase (Las Vegas).

statuses.quote: Texas coach Jerritt Elliott said sophomore outside hitter Abby Vander Wal is out for the season with the knee injury that she suffered on Saturday night.
statuses.summary: Coach-reported: expected to miss the remainder of 2026
statuses.note: The coach-reported SEASON OUTLOOK, attributed separately from the MRI report: Sports Illustrated / On SI (Paige Durrenberger, 2026-08-30), quoting Lincoln Arneal's report of Jerritt Elliott's statement. Not a Texas Athletics release.
